rows.label: Concept
rows.text: A dielectric polarises and has K greater than 1. It multiplies the capacitance by K. With free charge fixed, the potential difference falls. With the battery connected, the potential stays and the charge rises. The Coulomb force in the medium is the vacuum force divided by K.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: K = 1 for vacuum.  ·  The dielectric must fill the gap in the simple formula.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: A dielectric is an insulating material. Its molecules polarise in an electric field, so a thin layer of bound charge appears on the surfaces.  ·  The dielectric constant K, also called the relative permittivity, is the factor by which the capacitance of a vacuum capacitor increases when the dielectric fills it: C = K C_0. For vacuum, K = 1. For water and many insulators, K is greater than 1.

rows.label: Key points
rows.text: A dielectric is an insulator.  ·  K is greater than 1.  ·  It increases capacitance.  ·  It reduces the field inside, for a given free charge.

rows.label: Universal facts

rows.text: What happens to the force between charges in a medium?

rows.text: A vacuum capacitor has C_0 = 2.0 μF. A dielectric of K = 4 fills it. The capacitor is isolated with charge fixed. Find the new capacitance and say what happens to the potential difference.

rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: With the charge on the plates held fixed, the polarisation opposes the field, so the net field and the potential difference fall. Since C = Q/V, a smaller V means a larger C.  ·  The force between two charges in a uniform medium is the vacuum force divided by K. The medium does not remove the charges. It reduces the force.  ·  A dielectric lets the capacitor be used at a higher voltage before sparking, up to the dielectric strength. That is a separate limit from the value of K.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: K is not less than 1 for ordinary materials.  ·  Battery connected and battery disconnected give different changes.  ·  Bound charge is not free charge from the battery.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: Dielectric strength is a breakdown field, not the same number as K.  ·  Say whether the battery stays connected.  ·  K has no unit.
